data.transcript: This pizza has 34 grams of protein per slice. Start with one cup of cottage cheese, crack in two eggs and add two scoops of protein powder. I'm using Transparent Labs Unflavored. Then mix it up and pour it out into a pan, spread out your crust. Once you do, then you're going to bake, very important, until it's golden brown. Once that is done you're gonna wanna let it cool down slightly before adding your pizza sauce. I used pasta sauce which turned out great, add mozzarella. Add your toppings, I went with spinach, tomatoes and chicken for extra protein. Then bake it again and then once it was baked, I added red pepper flakes and Mike's Hot Honey if you like that sweet spicy combo like me. Slice it up and that's a legit high-protein pizza. Enjoy.
